pro_course_detail.title: Let's chat!
pro_course_detail.description:
In this class, we can talk about whatever you want. We can have an informal conversation about your interests and general topics, or I can prepare some questions for discussion. I will correct you, help you with pronunciation and teach you new vocabulary/phrases.

This is your time, so I expect you to do most of the talking! :) As a student myself, I understand how difficult it can be to have a conversation in a foreign language, so don't be nervous - I'm here to help you improve your conversational skills.

I'm looking forward to our conversation!

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar and vocabulary
pro_course_detail.description:
In this class, we will do grammar and vocabulary building exercises, and we will work on improving your fluency.

I will tailor the class to your needs, and we can focus on the areas in which you want to improve. We will work using exercises and materials from textbooks, authentic materials, and targeted practice to enable you to use the newly acquired grammar and vocabulary in conversation, writing and real life situations.

This class is suitable for both beginners and advanced students.

pro_course_detail.title: Exam preparation FCE/CAE/CPE and IELTS
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you need to prepare for an exam? I can help you!

In this class, we will prepare for the Cambridge FCE, CAE or CPE exams, or the IELTs exam. We will study using materials from exam preparation textbooks, other materials which will help you to learn the grammar and vocabulary that you need, and we can practice doing mock tests.

We will also practice using the language that you learn in these lessons in conversations, or by reading authentic texts. It is important to use the vocabulary and grammar structures that you need to learn for these exams, in order to better understand and remember them.

I have helped a lot of students to prepare for and pass their exams, and I will be very happy to help you too!

pro_course_detail.title: Academic writing
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you need to improve your English for your school or university studies? Would you like some help to prepare, research, write and/or edit your thesis or dissertation? Or do you need help to improve your essay writing skills? 

If so, this is the class for you. I specialise in humanities, social studies, psychology, art and history, but if you need help in another academic field, please write to me and we can discuss how I might be able to help you.

This class is for intermediate to advanced students.

pro_course_detail.title: English literature
pro_course_detail.description: In this class, we will read a book, short story or poetry together. We can read the book, story or poem in class and I will correct your pronunciation, or you can read for homework. We will discuss any new vocabulary and phrases, and we can analyse the content and themes of the book, story or poem. I can also set related essay questions if you would like to use our reading material as a resource to practice your writing skills.

pro_course_detail.title: German for beginners / Deutsch für Anfänger
pro_course_detail.description:
This is a course for absolute beginners who are fluent in English, and who would like to gain a firm foundation in German with a teacher who has also studied German as a second language. The course will focus on correct pronunciation (starting with the alphabet), speaking and grammar. By the end of the course, you will be able to have simple conversations, read simple texts, and travel independently as a tourist in German-speaking countries.

This course is also suitable for students who would like to prepare for the exam Start Deutsch 1.

teacher_info.introduction:
Are you looking to improve your English skills? Pass an exam? Impress in an interview? If yes, you have come to the right place. 

Teaching English as a foreign language is my job and I make sure my students get what they need from my sessions, whether it is general English skills, exam focus, presentation skills or interview practice. 

In our sessions together we will focus on speaking and work on any specific topics depending on student goals. I strongly believe that students must feel relaxed and confident in our sessions to ensure maximum interaction, thus speeding up the learning process. 

During our trial session I will assess your spoken English and prior to our first session, I will send a small but comprehensive English level test to understand more how to help you reach your goals. We will discuss your needs and talk about the areas that you need to improve. 

A bit about me ....

I was born in London and after completing a BA (HONS) Degree in English Studies (including modules on TEFL) I moved to Greece, where I have been working as a teacher. I have spent the past 19 years teaching all age groups and all levels, and feel I am fully equipped to help all students, no matter their level.  Living in Greece, I can assure you that I understand how important it is to feel confident and at ease while learning a foreign language

course_info.trial_description:
This is a relaxed and informal 30 minutes of conversation.  It gives me the opportunity to find out more about you and gives you the opportunity to find out more about me. 

Some of the things we will talk about are:

- how long you have been learning English
- how you use English now or will need to use English in the future
- how confident you feel about speaking, listening, reading, writing, grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation
- what you enjoy or dislike about learning English
- what your aim is in improving your English
- what your work is and what interests or hobbies you have
- what topics interest you
- what sort of lessons you like and how you learn best.

This will help me to get an idea about your current ability and motivation for learning English.

I will also tell you more about me and give you the opportunity to ask me questions - so you can decide if I am the right teacher for you.

pro_course_detail.title: Let's Talk Business - English for Business and Work
pro_course_detail.description:
To improve your practical business communications skills such as negotiating, presentations, using the telephone, emails and report writing, meetings and socializing.

Firstly, I will create your personal learning plan:

1. ASSESSMENT
An assessment of your current ability in one or more of the communication skills:
- speaking
- listening
- writing
- reading 

2. WHEN DO YOU USE ENGLISH?
When do you use English in your business? 
For example: 
- meetings
- sales negotiations
- writing emails and reports
- giving presentations
- on the telephone
- entertaining customers 

3. YOUR PERSONAL AIMS
Clear statements of what you want to achieve by improving your business English.
Examples of aims:
- “to be able to take part effectively in business meetings”
- "to give compelling sales presentations of my company's products"

4. YOUR OBJECTIVES
Each aim will have one or more specific objectives.
These are things you need to do to achieve your aim. 
For example:
Aim - “to be able to take part effectively in business meetings”
Objective - “to be able to use phrases and expressions to ask for and give opinions”

5. COURSE CONTENT
Content, activities and tasks appropriate for your objectives.

I will use a broad and interesting range of course material for your lessons – including authentic content from your own business or industry – so that your learning is highly practical and relevant to your aims and objectives.

You will also learn about the cultural and formality aspects of doing business in an English-speaking environment.

6. LESSONS
Lessons are interactive, stimulating, enjoyable and effective. 
There will be error correction during the lesson where appropriate.

I will give feedback on what you did well; corrections; and further advice.

My business experience: IT, telecommunications, engineering.

pro_course_detail.title: General English - English for Everyday Life

Examples of aims:

4. YOUR OBJECTIVES
Each aim will have one or more specific objectives.
These are things you need to do to achieve your aim. 
For example:
Aim - “to be able to go on holiday to the USA and deal with day-to-day language”
Objective - “to be able to book a table in a restaurant; order and pay for a meal”

I will use a broad and interesting range of course material for your lessons – videos, news articles, recordings, text books, TV, radio, and website – so that your learning is highly practical and relevant to your aims and objectives.
